reviewProvenance.manualVisualComparison: Published candidate is a grayscale running warrior in tight outfit, one long dagger in each hand with a simple uniform base, hair mostly tied back. Source is a red-haired Katarina in elaborate rose-red flowing cape/ribbons, crouched lunging stance with a curved ornate blade, standing on a wide circular stone plinth containing a dropped armored opponent. The distinctive large ribbon spiral, costume, pose, arm/weapon arrangement and sculpted opponent/base are absent from the published statue. Source views 1–6 confirm the separate sculpture.
